film.title: If You're Gonna Be Mid, Be the Best | Hardwood Bricks
film.description:
Hardwood Bricks started on the brick streets of Athens, Ohio, where the MAC is the home league. Now it covers 27 conferences and 286 teams of mid-major college basketball.

The map in this video is real: every light is a campus, and every arc is a road trip on a 2026-27 schedule, about three million road miles in all.

We are thorough: a front page for 27 editions, a page for every team, travel maps, an odds screen, our own ratings model, Crunch Time, the At-Large Watch, and Tops and Bottoms.
We are classy: an anchor for every campus, and original films about real towns.
We are oh so saucy: MIDnight Weave, Study Hall, and Tiffany and Mateo.

If you're gonna be mid, be the best.

A Hardwood Bricks Productions video, in association with JuiceboxNationTV Entertainment. A 19 North Films production. The anchors are fictional AI anchors and are not affiliated with their schools. Original music.

Keep it mid. Keep it real. See more at https://hardwoodbricks.com
